blind.description: A stylized vintage brass telescope supported by a wooden tripod stand. The optical tube is rendered in smooth polished brass/gold with a dark green glass objective lens and an eyepiece. It is mounted on a brass U-shaped tilt yoke above three turned wooden tripod legs accented with brass fittings and joined by a central wooden spreader tray.
blind.from_above: The brass telescope tube extends vertically down the center line with its front objective lens facing downwards, while the three tripod legs splay outwards symmetrically beneath it.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% of the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2.3 to 2.5 feet tall), with a tripod leg span of approximately 1.5 feet.

notes: tripod footprint slightly wider than catalog expectation but realistic for stability
